title: Paul McCartney live: KeyArena, Seattle | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the KeyArena in Seattle, Washington, USA, on 3 November 2005.

It was the 24th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 13,492 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The Beatles performed at the venue, then known as the Seattle Coliseum, on 21 August 1964 and 25 August 1966. McCartney returned there on 17 April 2016 during the One On One Tour, and on 2 and 3 May 2022 during the Got Back Tour.
